incident_time: 15:17 2021 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 11 - 14 November 2021 The Stewards allow car 44 to start sprint qualifying In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 44, Lewis Hamilton, to start sprint qualifying, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
